en.html:
A tsurugi's eyes did not stop working at night. Still, night was not day simply because one wished it so. Searching would become harder; an ambush would become easier. If possible, settle this now.

Not even four or five hours had passed since the fight with the magistrate. That should hardly be enough to restore his position. Give him extraordinary strength of body and mind, even then he should only just be preparing to move.

Time to spare, no. Too late, also no.

Time to spare, no. Too late, also no.

ja.html:
闇夜の中であろうと劔冑の眼が利かなくなることは
ないにせよ、しかしやはり昼間とは勝手が異なる。
　探索の困難と奇襲の危険が増すのは否めなかった。
できることなら今の内に始末をつけたい。

　昼の代官との戦闘からまだ四、五時間とは経過して
いない。代官が態勢を立て直すには全く足りない筈だ。
　仮に彼がよほど心身の活力に恵まれていたとしても、
ようやくこれから動き出そうかというところだろう。

　余裕は期待できないが、手遅れではない。

en.html:
Kageaki"Where is he now?"
Kotaro"Where indeed? Busy man. Could be anywhere..."
Kageaki"..."
Kotaro"Ho, ho. By all means look about, but don't forget me completely. An old man feels lonely also, na."
Kotaro"Especially when he has been looking forward to this."
Kageaki"...Meaning?"
Kotaro"Tormenting the poor villagers had begun to bore me. No challenge, you see. All this talent sitting unused. Ho."
Kageaki"............One question. Why assist the magistrate? Surely that game is not your purpose."
Kotaro"Certainly not. I haven't that much free time. Wish I did."
Kageaki"..."
Kotaro"Money. An unpleasant subject, but money is required. Our clan served a distinguished house. Some time ago, that house made the wrong moves in the world. Finished. Abolished."
Kotaro"Down we went with it. Rank gone, income gone. Only our ancestral lands remained. A grand phrase for a little mountain holding where even coarse grain will hardly grow. Ho. Sit there and wait to wither, that was our future."
Kageaki"...Removed from the warrior register. Then your tsurugi—"
Kotaro"Was to be confiscated, naturally. I used my connections, begged mercy from the authorities, somehow got it overlooked. Immediately afterward, GHQ came hunting tsurugi. All that effort, down the drain."
Kageaki"...?"
Kotaro"Then comes Ichizo Sorimachi. A man wants to make a fortune mining, he tells me. Help him, and Sorimachi will pull the strings at GHQ and recover our tsurugi. That was his assurance."
Kotaro"Could I possibly fail to jump at it?"
Kageaki"..."

Help him, and Sorimachi will pull the strings at GHQ and recover our tsurugi. That was his assurance."Kotaro"Could I possibly fail to jump at it?"Kageaki"..."

en.html:
...Kuch gadbad. Something was wrong.
A small suspicion. Small did not mean it could be thrown away.

Sorimachi was doing far too much. Shogunate-hired gang on one side, occupation forces on the other, and himself the bridge between them. Clever living, probably. Nothing strange in that.

But such a useful fellow sits at home. People bring work. Easy work, generous payment, both should knock on his door. Why was the bridge walking from house to house requesting people to cross it?

If this account was true, his enthusiasm needed explaining. Too much running about for a comfortable go-between. Rokuhara here, foreign power there, and the middleman more energetic than either customer.

Phir this recovered tsurugi. GHQ forbade possession outside Yamato's regular army—currently Rokuhara. Confiscated the rest.

Many confiscated suits supposedly lay unused. Language difficulties, physiological incompatibilities: not convenient for GHQ officers. Little practical value attached to them, apparently.

Even so. Tsurugi hai. Not an umbrella the neighbor forgot to return. 'Arre, yours is lying useless, give it back, na'—and the army sends it over?

A mere liaison asks, out it comes. Believe that, and I would be neglecting my head's remaining responsibilities. Some further business lay behind this business.

While I considered it, the strange person before me finished the explanation.

ja.html:
……妙だ。
　
　一抹の疑念を、俺は看過しかねた。

　雪車町という男、<ruby>積極的に動き過ぎている<rt>・・・・・・・・・・・</rt></ruby>。
　幕府御雇組に草鞋を脱ぐ一方、進駐軍にも顔を売り
両者の橋渡し役を務める、そういう人物がいることに
不思議はない。おそらくは、賢い世渡りの一つだ。

　しかしそういう、一部社会で非常に重宝する人間は、
他人に求められ<ruby>使われる<rt>・・・・</rt></ruby>ものだ。自分から売り込んで
回ったりはしない。わざわざそんなことをせずとも、
軽い仕事と高い報酬の組み合わせが足繁く通ってくる。

　聞いた話を信じるならば、だが。雪車町の<ruby>能動的<rt>アクティブ</rt></ruby>な
行動はやや不審だった。
　<ruby>国内権力<rt>ろくはら</rt></ruby>と<ruby>国外権力<rt>ＧＨＱ</rt></ruby>の仲介者という気楽な立場には
そぐわない。

　加えて、劔冑の返却を手配したという話もまた疑念
を呼ぶ。
　ＧＨＱは大和の正規軍――現在は即ち六波羅――を
除いて劔冑の所持を禁じ、没収する措置を取っている。

　そうして没収された劔冑の多くは、ただ死蔵されて
いるという。言語上あるいは体質の問題によりＧＨＱ
士官が用いるには不都合が多いため、利用価値を認め
られていないようだ。しかしそれでも、劔冑は劔冑。

　一介の連絡役の要望で簡単に持ち出せるとはどうも
信じ難かった。何がしかの<ruby>裏<rt>・</rt></ruby>があるとしか思えない。
　……そんな俺の疑念をよそに、目前の怪人は説明を
締めくくる。

Kotaro"Yahi haal hai. To feed my clan, I must make the magistrate's scheme succeed. His enemy becomes my enemy. And here we are, police sahib. Your luck has finished its working day."
Kageaki"...Circumstances understood. For that purpose, this village may be sacrificed? Acceptable to you?"
Kotaro"Hm? Tedious speech chahiye? Strong eat the weak, duniya ka niyam, all that? Insist, I can provide. But sharam dono ko aayegi. Me saying it, you having to stand through the whole thing. Why spoil a pleasant killing with a bad lecture?"
Kageaki"...Entirely."
Kotaro"Ho-ho. Then that nonsense we leave."
Kotaro"Kageaki Minato... correct? Now let this old man taste the edge of your spider, na. Muramasa?"
Kageaki"!"
Muramasa《————》

小太郎「とまあ、そういう次第でな。 　一族を食わすためには代官の目論見を成就 せしめねばならん。である以上、代官の敵は 儂の敵、ここで会ったが百年目となるわけよ」
景明「……御事情は理解した。 　その為に、この村を犠牲にするもやむ無し というお考えか」
小太郎「うん？　何ぞ、つまらんことを言わせたい のかの。弱肉強食だの、どうのこうのと。 　たっての要望とあらば口にせんではないが、 言う方も聞く方も恥ずかしくはないかね？」
景明「……全くに」
小太郎「ほっほっ。 　そのようなことはどうでも良かろうて」
小太郎「湊斗景明殿……で、確かかな？ 　さぁ、そろそろそちらの蜘蛛、村正の刃味はあじ を儂に味わわせてはくれぬかね？」
景明「！」
村正《――――》
